text_block_list.text: As part of my studies, I came to watch the local half-marathon.
While watching over the race――

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Incredible! Ines Fujin bursts out in a flash right from the start!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Out of the way, coming through!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So I don't have any regrets... I'm going as far and as hard as I can!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My race strategy, you ask?
Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If it were me, I would take up a favorable forward position early on while observing the situation, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I think it's better to break away with a lightning start dash. And then pull ahead further and further!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, if you go all-out from the very beginning, running out of stamina in the final stretch becomes a serious concern, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ines-san,
do you happen to have a secret plan of some sort?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I sure do!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: My secret plan is――believing in myself!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I definitely won't gas out!
I'm gonna sprint through with everything I've got and win this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Seizing that moment of victory...
I'll show everyone a run my family can truly be proud of!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: N-O-W, GOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa?! Ines Fujin accelerates once again right before the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: She's pulling further and further away from the pack behind her! Astounding! Simply astounding, Ines Fujin!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: GOOOOAAAL!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Ines Fujin!!
A front-running victory achieved with phenomenal speed!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: *haah*... *haah*...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The goal... is right there, and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: What's this?! Has Ines Fujin completely run out of gas?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Here comes second place closing in fast! Ines Fujin can't hold her off!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
This is――an utterly unbelievable comeback victory!!
Ines Fujin falls just one step short!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Goodness.
In the end, it was nothing more than running out front on sheer grit, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's perfectly fine!
Win or lose, I didn't want to have any regrets!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Clumsy as I am, the only thing I can really do... is keep pushing forward frantically.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Pushing forward, forward, just relentlessly moving forward.
If I do that, you know――

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Even someone like me might be able to leave behind a brilliant, shining sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: In a race where I blast off from the start and never gas out until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"What an unsubstantiated notion..."
is what I would like to say, but...

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Ines! Ines!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hearing these cheers, I feel as though I might actually come to believe it, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That across the long, storied history of the Twinkle Series, a moment will arrive where you shine at your absolute brightest.
